title: X4: synthetic Marpet isolation tests and explicit wipe-proof gap
public_pr_body:
Adds 20 passing Vitest/SQL checks in a freshly created nonce-labelled, network-isolated PostgreSQL container. Uses actual main 006 RBAC, 121 membership resolver and 036 helpers on 16 minimal synthetic business tables, plus the unchanged private dln_numbering_pending definition/grants from public release 147 at 31f965e7. No candidate branch or #359 is edited.

Checks JNR read/update/delete/move refusals, forged company choice, denied numbering-hold access, preservation of Marpet rows and both holds during a fixture-only JNR purge, and atomic refusal of a deliberately bad global delete. Accepts no DB URL. Records SQL hashes, commit/environment/time/exits and original logs; committed code 64912e0 rerun: 20 passed, zero skipped. TypeScript and scoped lint pass. Startup/readiness and type-setup failures are retained; security assertions unchanged. Raw evidence whitespace preserved byte-for-byte.

X4: review done, 1 remaining evidence gap. The approved actual JNR wipe artifact is absent from the public trees; actual-wipe proof remains NOT EXECUTED. The fixture purge is explicitly not that kit. Full final-schema/Auth/Storage/audit and live Marpet preservation are not claimed. See tests/reviews/x4/README.md for the acceptance gate and blank record.

Branch from main 68f89ca. Docs/tests only; synthetic data only; no merge, production SQL, Ready label, private source, or message to John.
